blind.description: A stylized gothic stone pedestal or pillar consisting of a square flat capital with an inlaid spiderweb pattern, an upper capital adorned with a sculpted spider in relief with legs wrapping around the column, a slender four-sided shaft with recessed pointed gothic arch panels, and a stepped square plinth base with matching gothic trim. Surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with no shards, spikes, blobs, holes, or floating flakes, and no hovering unattached geometry. Underside sits completely flat and flush on the floor on its integrated base with no extra terrain slab. Coloured in beige/cream stone, dark purple/burgundy recessed panels, and reddish-brown/bronze stone on the spider. No unpainted or plain black areas, and no flames or emissive glow.
blind.from_above: A square stone platform or tile with corner brackets containing an eight-spoked radial spiderweb design with concentric connecting strands in cream stone against dark purple/maroon recessed cells.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.6 times as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (approximately 9 to 9.5 ft tall); its base and top platform are about 4.5 to 5 ft wide (roughly 80% of the figure's height).
